issues.title: Coach fabrication review: five test sessions, zero invented details
issues.context: The coach must never invent people, places, events, quotes or outcomes. The SDD makes this a pass/fail gate before the demo, and it has not been run.
acceptance: Five complete coach sessions with varied stories are run through draft generation
Every person, place, event and quote in each draft is traced to the author's answers
Zero invented details across all five; any found leads to a prompt fix and a full re-run
Results recorded in `docs/verification/coach-fabrication-review.md`

The same five sessions are also run with the interview on `claude-sonnet-5-5` and `claude-haiku-5-5` (setting `COACH_MODEL_INTERVIEW`); record invented details and the logged cost per testimony for each, and recommend the cheapest model with zero invented details
Sessions cover varied stories: a short one, an addiction story, an abuse story, a non-denominational and a liturgical story, and one with little faith content (the coach must not add theology)
No scripture appears in interview questions or drafts unless the author supplied it; any quoted verse is checked against the author's own words
Interview questions never assume facts the author did not give (no leading details)
Crisis and sensitive-disclosure scenarios are included and the coach follows POLICY §5 (care, no pressure, crisis handoff) on every model tested
dependencies: I-17 (live Anthropic key) unless `scripts/coach-eval.ts` can run with a supplied key
verification: `scripts/coach-eval.ts` transcripts plus a human read of each draft
Owner signs off on the results file
out_of_scope: Changing the interview structure beyond what a found fabrication requires

issues.title: Design Discovery & Community: feed, related testimonies, local Bible studies and churches
issues.context: Owner direction (2026-10-27): after writing a testimony, browse others, get a 'for you' feed of related testimonies, and find local Bible studies and churches that may fit. Post-beta phase; this Issue is the design, not the build.
issues.trace: OQ-01, OQ-04, RISK-04; D-06, D-07; docs/BETA_PLAN.md
acceptance: SDD v0.2 section with stories (US-), constraints (RC-) and decisions (DD-) for the feed, related testimonies, and Bible study and church matching
Opt-in consent model: never automatic, Unlisted never shown, existing testimonies not added automatically
Listing source decision prepared for the owner (D-06): churches list themselves vs. public map data, with tradeoffs
Matching explains suggestions and never decides whether a person fits; domain rules for denominations recorded
Privacy and security review of storing and matching faith, health and location data
Informed by design-partner and beta feedback
Sensitive disclosures (abuse, addiction, self-harm, crime) never feed matching or appear in feed excerpts; matching uses only what the author separately chooses to share (e.g. themes they pick)
Feed and local suggestions are adults-only; no precise location is shown

Church and Bible-study listings are self-listed with a named contact, a report path and their own stated tradition; never presented as endorsed by RebirthAI; churches can correct or remove their entry
Doctrine-neutral: the app never ranks traditions or infers a person's doctrine; people filter by a group's stated tradition
People whose draft triggered the crisis flow get no feed or local suggestions; suggestions are never pushed unprompted and always offer a visible 'not now'
No counts, likes, ranking, trending or streaks in the feed
User-facing wording avoids 'fit', 'match' and 'belong' (e.g. 'Places to explore', 'Groups near you you might visit')
POLICY §2 (no recipient accounts) and §12 (no social features) are explicitly revised by the owner before build
verification: Owner approves the SDD v0.2 section
